results.title: Elena Rybakina crushes Leylah Fernandez to win Ningbo Open title
results.description: World number one Elena Rybakina won her fourth title of an outstanding season with a ruthless straight-sets victory over Leylah Fernandez in the Ningbo Open final on Sunday. The top seed and defending champion cruised to a 6-2, 6-2 win in 73 minutes over the world number 30 from Canada. Rybakina, the Australian and US Open champion, collected her 15th WTA crown in all and went a long way towards securing the year-end number-one ranking. results.title: Cameron Green Set to Make Comeback in Decisive Test Against South Africa
results.description: Cameron Green is poised to make his return for Australia in the crucial third Test against South Africa, following a swift recovery from an abdominal injury. The series stands at 1-1, with both teams eager to claim victory. Green reflects on his injury's unusual nature and his experiences facing South Africa's formidable bowling attack. His recent performance against Bangladesh showcases his potential impact in the upcoming match. As the final Test approaches, fans are eager to see how Green's presence will influence the outcome of the series.
